mr_title: perf(material/tooltip): Defer injection of injectables not needed until tooltip is shown.

expected_issues.title: ViewContainerRef injected lazily after the view is rendered
expected_issues.description:
ViewContainerRef is no longer injected in the constructor but fetched lazily from the injector when the tooltip is first shown; injecting ViewContainerRef creates an anchor node next to the host, so doing it late changes the DOM structure of the host's view at an arbitrary time.

In Angular, injecting ViewContainerRef on a node materialises a container (comment anchor) for that element. When this happens during the component's creation the view shape is stable; creating it on first hover inserts a new node into an already rendered view, which breaks consumers relying on DOM structure/order (e.g. CSS sibling selectors, :last-child, content projection tests) and can differ between hovered and non-hovered instances. ViewContainerRef must be injected eagerly; only the other services can be deferred.
